title: S1CogBench public aggregate result row

status.description: Row state. Accepted cells: available_full_protocol and the complete_* source states. Table 3 cells without a value: not_applicable_readout (n.a.: no option probabilities for an NLL target), partial_records_retained (part.), not_evaluated (n.e.: outside the measured scope), non_full_prefix_only (n.f.), cancelled_before_generation (canc.), all_responses_invalid (inv.). Local runs of python -m s1cogbench: user_supplied_full_protocol, user_supplied_incomplete.

table2_marker.description: The marker printed in the Table 3 cell when the row has no value; null otherwise.

notes: Context keys define comparable views; do not collapse distinct protocols, reward families, horizons, units or targets.
Latency additionally requires matching runtime_context and notes. Shared-GPU timings are not isolated model speed or human reaction time.
n is the original aggregation denominator and can mean responses, participants or episodes; interpret with aggregation.
No overall cognitive score or cross-task normalized ranking is supplied.
A row with a table2_marker has value null and value_status undefined; its status names the marker. Do not read it as a zero or a missing run of an applicable target.

API rows (model_access api in results.json) keep the provider readout in runtime_context.readout: native typed choice (Jev), generated FINAL line (Claude; human-NLL targets n.a.), or stated probabilities (Claude Haiku on four modes). Stated probabilities are not internal model probabilities.
